fact: The Federal Ministry of Health began adopting the SmartCare EMR (later Tena Care) in 2009, a system developed by the US CDC and customised and maintained by the Tulane University Technical Assistance Project in Ethiopia; at the October to December 2019 survey it was functioning at Ayder referral hospital, where all medical services depended on it, while St. Paul's hospital, after failed deployments in 2009, 2014 and 2017, worked predominantly on paper records.
title: Implementation challenges and perception of care providers on Electronic Medical Records at St. Paul's and Ayder Hospitals, Ethiopia
publisher: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
